verdict.rationale: Langfuse can be self-hosted for free under the MIT license on your own infrastructure. Documented options include Docker Compose, Kubernetes (Helm), and Terraform for AWS, Azure and GCP, and it runs the same infrastructure as Langfuse Cloud. That gives full control over where data lives, but only if you operate the deployment yourself. missing for 10: evidence of region or residency selection on managed Langfuse Cloud, first-party data-residency documentation, independent hands-on corroboration.
